angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,245,303 km at 397.04 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.5186 +/- 0.0195 mas (same row, RUWE 1.02): 397.04 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.79 +/- 0.48 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,245,303 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.82 +/- 1.45 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6446 +/- 88 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-33.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.192, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-33 (pscomppars): spectral type F4, from Bourrier et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..63B/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HAT-P-33: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-33 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.05 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-33 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.618, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-33 (pscomppars): age 2.3 Gyr, from Bourrier et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..63B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-33 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 15.57 km/s, from Bourrier et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..63B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
